lines.text: Nobody could leave this lodge. Yet a necklace vanished.
Road buried in snow. So the thief? Still inside.
Suspect one, Chef Marco: I was baking bread all night!
And the oven log agrees. Loaf out at 11:45.
lines.say: And the oven log agrees. Loaf out at eleven forty-five.

lines.text: Suspect two, Ms. Vale: Asleep in room four, I swear.
Suspect three, Brody, the ski guide, just stomped in from the village.
Two miles through the snow, he said. Got back at 11:30.
lines.say: Two miles through the snow, he said. Got back at eleven thirty.

lines.text: So Inspector Hale stepped outside to check.
The storm stopped at ten. And the snow by the door? Perfectly smooth.
So Brody never left. His boots? Bone dry.
And tucked inside the left one... the necklace.
Case closed. So... did you check the snow?
